name: contractor-missed-call-dispatcher
description: Captures missed trade contractor calls, executes instant SMS text-backs, triages emergency plumbing/HVAC/electrical issues, and stages qualified estimates in Jobber, ServiceTitan, or calendar.

scripts.build:app: bun build apps/call-dispatcher/src/main.tsx --outdir apps/call-dispatcher/dist --target browser --format esm --jsx-factory=h --jsx-fragment=Fragment --jsx-import-source=preact
